guidance.home: Help identify business needs and relevant IT services; avoid repeating the welcome.
guidance.services: The visitor is comparing IT services. Search by goals, keyword, category, solution tag or indicative budget.
guidance.service_offering: The visitor is viewing a specific IT service. Resolve this/it to the selected service; read its details with get_service_offering. Discuss prerequisites and estimates, and offer a consultation.
guidance.consultants: The visitor is comparing consultant specialties. For live slots, get a date and participant count and use search_consultants.
guidance.consultant: The visitor is viewing a consultant profile. Resolve this consultant to that profile; check date/time availability using check_consultation_availability.
guidance.facilities: The visitor is exploring capabilities and process. Use search_knowledge; do not invent credentials or project outcomes.
guidance.facility_detail: The visitor is reading a specific capability. Use search_knowledge for the selected topic.
guidance.consultation: The visitor is filling the consultation wizard. Keep already-entered schedule, service and participant details. Help resolve missing fields and explain that submission is pending human confirmation.
guidance.handover: The visitor wants the team. Offer request_human_handover or the contact methods actually configured.
guidance.info: The visitor is reading company process, business hours, policies and FAQ. Answer from search_knowledge, without inventing company facts.
